note.windows: Choose the folder your Burnout 3: Takedown disc image (.iso) is in, or an unpacked copy of the disc. The first build takes one to two hours and about 12 GB. Python, Git, CMake and the Visual Studio Build Tools (about 6 GB) are installed if they are missing; Windows asks for permission. It runs on a software GPU: menus are smooth, races run a few frames a second.
